title: Matched current-v6 soup uniform-pool diversity 65k pilot
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: From the strongest current-v6 external-tested soup, replacing four identical learned-opponent slots with four diverse current-v6 frozen policies while retaining a matched 50% procedural curriculum will produce a more general learned update than the duplicate-soup control without materially worsening source-contract drift.
material_change: Train two fresh 65,536-physical-hand all-policy-head continuations from the exact soup. Both use four pool slots, identical seed/deals/group assignments/procedural share/KL/optimizer reset; control repeats the soup in all four slots, treatment substitutes soup, raw actor, parent-KL tail, and source-KL-temperature endpoint.
baseline: Frozen source soup current-v6 greedy fresh20k: -41.8162 bb/100, CI entirely negative. Old Standard10-initialized learned leagues and all-procedural training failed; neither isolated learned diversity from this stronger current-v6 start under a mixed curriculum.

notes: Preregistered endpoint: if both arms terminate at the same iteration, use each final raw actor; otherwise use the highest common archived iteration at which both have crossed no more than the lower arm's final physical count. No endpoint selection by reward. Required health: exact source/pool hashes, identical normalized assignment schedule, physical target, fresh optimizer/counters, allowed tensor scope, finite metrics, zero KL stops, session audit PASS.

After health, run untouched common-randomness learned/procedural diagnostics and outcome-blind source-state drift. Internal anchors are diagnostic only because prior proxy rankings failed externally. A separately logged direct fresh Slumbot cohort is allowed only for the frozen matched endpoints and must compare both arms; no 100k qualification from this pilot.

Control frozen at the preregistered physical threshold endpoint iter16: 68,029 physical/66,033 transition hands, optimizer step464, max source KL0.004724, zero stops; session audit PASS with16 archives and16 exact assignment records.

Treatment frozen at iter16: 67,976 physical/65,923 transition hands, optimizer step480, max source KL0.003514, zero stops; session audit PASS. Both arms changed only the same ten allowed tensors and their 16 local-index assignment schedules are exactly equal.

Untouched 6,144-pair learned panel: pooled treatment-control -0.0594 bb/100 CI[-22.0376,21.9187],1/3 positive. Per-anchor deltas Standard10 -14.4275, slumbot_free -3.8694, CFR96 +18.1187; all paired CIs cross zero.

Independent terminal review PASS: both session audits, 16-row matched local assignments, checkpoint hashes, all6,144 raw learned-panel pairs/decks/CIs, and all60,671 source-state rows/hashes/means recomputed exactly. 29 tests PASS.

result.summary: Matched soup-initialized 65k arms completed 136,005 physical training hands with exact assignment control. Diverse learned opponents gave pooled -0.0594 bb/100 CI[-22.0376,21.9187], only1/3 positive anchors, and worsened source-state drift to TV0.02208/disagreement0.02421 versus control0.01951/0.01998.
result.conclusion: Replacing duplicate-soup opponent slots with the selected diverse current-v6 pool produced no detectable generalization gain and crossed the source-state preservation boundary. Learned-opponent diversity at this scale/distribution is rejected; no Slumbot hands are allocated to the treatment.
result.next_step: Do not scale or externally test the diversity treatment. The duplicate-soup mixed-curriculum control independently passed the outcome-blind <=0.02 source-state preservation thresholds and was not selected by internal performance; log one exploratory fresh5k current-v6 greedy transfer cohort for that frozen control. Only a credible direct improvement over the soup's -41.8162 fresh20k reference may justify confirmation.
